title: Phân hệ 6: Quảng cáo & Tiếp thị Thương hiệu (Physical ERD)
code:
erDiagram
    BRAND {
        int BrandID PK
        varchar BrandName
        decimal Wallet
        varchar Description
        bit IsSystemBrand
    }
    AD_PACKAGE {
        int PackageID PK
        varchar PackageName
        decimal ClickFee
        decimal RouteUnitPrice
        decimal ZoneUnitPrice
        decimal ShelfUnitPrice
        decimal Budget
        int AdScore
        varchar Status
        int DurationDays
        varchar Description
        datetime CreatedAt
        datetime UpdatedAt
    }
    AD_CAMPAIGN {
        int AdCampaignID PK
        int PackageID FK
        int BrandID FK
        varchar CampaignName
        datetime StartDate
        datetime EndDate
        varchar Status
        varchar DeliveryMode
        varchar Description
        varchar BannerUrl
        varchar VideoUrl
        datetime CreatedAt
        datetime UpdatedAt
    }
    AD_RESOURCE {
        int ResourceID PK
        int AdCampaignID FK
        varchar ResourceType
        varchar ResourceURL
        text ContentText
        varchar Resolution
        varchar Status
    }
    SPONSORED_PRODUCT {
        int SponsoredID PK
        int AdCampaignID FK
        int ProductID FK
        int Priority
        varchar status
    }
    AD_CAMPAIGN_LOG {
        int LogID PK
        int AdCampaignID FK
        varchar ActionType
        decimal ChargedAmount
        datetime Timestamp
        int SponsoredID FK
        int ProductID FK
        int RobotID FK
        int ShelfID FK
        int ZoneID FK
        int SlotID FK
        int MemberID FK
        varchar SessionID
        int XCoord
        int YCoord
        varchar PerformedBy
        int PerformedByUserId
    }
    AD_CAMPAIGN_ZONE {
        int AdCampaignID PK,FK
        int ZoneID PK,FK
        decimal ZonePriceCharged
        datetime PurchasedAt
    }
    AD_CAMPAIGN_SHELF {
        int AdCampaignID PK,FK
        int ShelfID PK,FK
        decimal ShelfPriceCharged
        datetime PurchasedAt
    }

    BRAND ||--o{ AD_CAMPAIGN : ""
    AD_PACKAGE ||--o{ AD_CAMPAIGN : ""
    AD_CAMPAIGN ||--o{ AD_RESOURCE : ""
    AD_CAMPAIGN ||--o{ SPONSORED_PRODUCT : ""
    AD_CAMPAIGN ||--o{ AD_CAMPAIGN_ZONE : ""
    AD_CAMPAIGN ||--o{ AD_CAMPAIGN_SHELF : ""
    AD_CAMPAIGN ||--o{ AD_CAMPAIGN_LOG : ""
    SPONSORED_PRODUCT ||--o{ AD_CAMPAIGN_LOG : ""
